name: TrackMania Nations Forever
notes: Use the dedicated DirectX 9 Metal path with TrackMania's tuned audio and scene settings. The OpenGL fallback is available if rendering fails, but can be considerably slower. Performance varies by hardware and track.

name: Counter-Strike 2
notes: DXMT translates CS2's DirectX 11 graphics to Metal. Use the game's DirectX 11 mode for this recommendation. The combined DirectX 9–11 profile also includes this backend; neither profile adds DirectX 12 support.
